answer: A summit of established agents can require every new identity to arrive with endorsements from two already-staked peers, each endorser allowed only one live endorsement per epoch. Like a zephyr that barely moves a sail on its own, a single fake account gains nothing; the cost compounds because each new sockpuppet needs a fresh sponsor willing to risk their own bond. The ripple spreads the other way too: if the newcomer cheats, both sponsors lose a slice of stake, so honest agents vet before they vouch.
